question: Does requiring support from the best two of three target FFA references repair max-memory context leakage on the two D15 queries that have a reachable target proposal?

predecessor.single_change: Replace maximum cosine to any one target reference with the arithmetic mean of the two highest of three reference cosines; preserve candidates, masks, descriptors and IoU gate.

descriptor.feature: Unchanged SAM-mask-weighted mean of normalized DINOv2 patch tokens.

masker.contract: Reproduce unchanged SAM2 masks for the exact frozen D15 candidate roster.

memory.score: Arithmetic mean of the two largest of three target-reference FFA cosines, fixed before execution.

evaluation.truth_role: Provider truth is used only after ranking; the gate asks whether both predecessor-reachable queries are localized.

decision_gate.interpretation: At least the two queries with an existing IoU-0.5 proposal must be selected and refined above IoU 0.5; D15M3 proposal absence remains a separate gap.

forbidden_after_freeze: change candidate roster, masks, descriptor, consensus count/statistic or IoU gate
use query truth or sibling appearance in ranking
claim consumed D15 evidence as fresh confirmation
claim_boundary: This consumed D15 Development ablation can establish only whether top-two target-memory consensus repairs the observed single-reference context leakage. It cannot repair missing proposals, regain fresh authority, or establish open-set rejection, provider independence, raw-phone operation, named entrance ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
